attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page says plainly where its account comes from: he was a martyr unknown to the Synaxaristes of Saint Nicodemus and to the printed Menaia, and is written in the Parisian Codex 1621, where there is also a short biographical notice of him. That is a statement of a single manuscript witness and not the site's own mark of doubt: there is no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on this page. The names Ἰούλιος and Αἰλιανός are the magistrates he was brought before, not companions, and no `related` row is made for them. No hymn is printed.
